title: NFT Minting in Gallery with Wallet Identity Assignment and Address Display

requirements.text: Add a clearly visible 'Mint NFT' button in the NFT Gallery page that opens a minting modal/form. The user must be logged in with Internet Identity to mint. The mint action must call the backend's mint function and associate the minted NFT with the caller's principal (Identity).

quotes: mache mir die Galerie so, daß ich NFTs minten kann

acceptanceCriteria: A 'Mint NFT' button is visible in the NFT Gallery page
Clicking the button when not logged in prompts the user to log in with Internet Identity
When logged in, a minting form/modal opens allowing the user to select an image, enter a title and description
Clicking confirm triggers the backend mint call with the authenticated caller's principal
A success message is shown after successful minting
The newly minted NFT appears in the gallery and in the user's minted NFTs list without a page reload

requirements.text: Display the authenticated user's ICP principal address (from Internet Identity) prominently in the NFT Gallery page. It should be shown as a copyable field. Also display the canister's principal address so users know the on-chain location of the NFT contract.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is logged in, their principal ID is displayed in the NFT Gallery page
The principal ID can be copied to clipboard with a single click
The canister principal address is also displayed and copyable
If the user is not logged in, a placeholder or login prompt is shown instead of the address

requirements.text: Ensure that minted NFTs are stored in the backend linked to the minting user's principal ID. Add a 'My NFTs' section or filter in the NFT Gallery page that shows only the NFTs minted by (and thus owned by) the currently logged-in Internet Identity principal.

quotes: die NFTs sich in meiner Wallet meiner Identity zugeordnet befinden

acceptanceCriteria: The backend stores each minted NFT with its owner principal
A query exists in the backend to fetch all NFTs owned by a given principal
The NFT Gallery page has a 'My NFTs' tab or filter section visible when the user is logged in
This section shows only NFTs whose owner principal matches the currently authenticated user's principal
The owner principal is displayed on each NFT card/detail in this section
If no NFTs are owned by the user, an appropriate empty state message is shown

requirements.text: Each NFT card in the gallery (both in the 'All NFTs' view and 'My NFTs' view) must display the owner's principal address (shortened) and the token ID. The NFT detail modal must display the full owner principal, token ID, mint date, and a link to the ICP dashboard/explorer for on-chain verification.

quotes: die NFTs sich in meiner Wallet meiner Identity zugeordnet befinden

acceptanceCriteria: Each NFT card shows a shortened owner principal (e.g., first 8 and last 4 characters)
Each NFT card shows the token ID
The NFT detail modal/view shows the full owner principal with a copy button
The NFT detail modal shows mint date and token ID
A link to the ICP dashboard explorer is provided for on-chain verification

constraints: All Motoko backend logic must remain in backend/main.mo as a single actor
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
NFT ownership must be tied to the Internet Identity principal — no other authentication mechanism
Do not use external databases or services; all state must be stored in the ICP canister
nonGoals: No external NFT marketplace integration (Getgems, OpenSea, etc.)
No ICP token payment for minting (credits handled by Caffeine platform)
